title: The Craft & Chemistry of Masala Chai
objective: Explain the scientific principles and culinary technique behind authentic masala chai: coarse spice crushing, water decoction kinetics, milk casein tannin binding, and rolling aeration.
audience: Tea lovers, home cooks, and food science enthusiasts looking for a visually captivating explainer of beverage craft.

message.core_message: Authentic masala chai is culinary chemistry: coarse crushing frees volatile oils, boiling in water extracts aromatics without lipid interference, and whole milk casein encapsulates sharp tannins into a velvety, aromatic emulsion.
key_points: Crush spices coarsely to release volatile essential oils without grinding cellular debris into bitter dust.
Water first: polar solvent extraction at 100°C maximizes mass transfer before adding dairy.
Whole milk casein proteins bind to sharp tannins, neutralizing harsh astringency into rich smoothness.
The rolling double-boil creates convective turbulence that homogenizes milk lipids into microfoam.
